outcome: Days to resumption of fluid intake
Days to resumption of solid food intake
cohort: Elderly (>=80 years) colorectal cancer patients with a history of abdominal surgery who underwent curative and elective surgery for stage 0 to III CRC.
finding: Laparoscopic surgery can be safely performed in elderly colorectal cancer patients with a history of abdominal surgery and results in a lower postoperative morbidity rate compared to open surgery.
